events.summary: Italy's transport minister Matteo Salvini says Italy "supports a swift EU approval of Tesla Assisted Driving" after a call with Elon Musk. No national recognition yet.
Tesla Europe: "Now approved in Latvia. Rollout begins soon." No date given.
Latvia's Ministry of Transport / CSDD recognises the RDW approval, the tenth EU country.
Tesla’s current support page lists nine European markets. The country list and vehicle eligibility conditions are tracked separately from legal recognition and individual installations.
Tesla Europe: "Now approved in Slovakia. Rollout begins soon." No date given.
Slovakia's Ministry of Transport recognises the RDW approval, the ninth EU country.
Flemish mobility minister Annick De Ridder tells parliament Belgium will not suspend or change its recognition; adjusting or removing the speed offset is being considered for the EU file.
The current Tesla support page uses Tesla Assisted Driving. The precise Europe-wide rename date is not established from a primary source.
Slovak transport minister says a recognition letter goes to the RDW within days.
119th TCMV lists only a continuation of discussions on the Dutch Art. 39 request. No vote.
German transport ministry backs EU-wide approval, with a 10% speed tolerance cap.
Croatia's DZM recognises the RDW approval, the eighth EU country.
Czech Ministry of Transport recognises the RDW approval.
Slovenia's AVP recognises the RDW approval (ministry notice 8 Sep).
France starts road tests of the system with two vehicles.
Hungary's transport ministry says it will wait for the EU decision.
Reuters: Finland may approve before the EU vote; Traficom reviewing.
Sweden's Trafikverket recommends the EU reject the system while it can exceed speed limits.
Belgium recognises the RDW approval.
Denmark's Færdselsstyrelsen recognises the RDW approval after its own review.
Estonia recognises the RDW approval.
Lithuania becomes the first state to recognise the Dutch approval.
Tesla asks Latvia to start recognising the RDW approval, according to a Ministry of Economics report.
RDW grants provisional EU type approval (Art. 39, Reg. (EU) 2018/858).
